# Japan Disaster Prep Check

> Free, unofficial household checklist for the emergency request (事前防災徹底のための緊急要請) issued by Japan's Disaster Management Agency (防災庁) on 2026-11-02, the day it launched. Five points: 1 耐震診断 for homes built 昭和56年 (1981) or earlier, plus furniture fixing; 2 stock water, food and portable toilets for at least 3 days, ideally 1 week (drinking water 3 L per person per day incl. cooking); 3 hazard maps, evacuation site and route; 4 grab bag (非常持ち出し品); 5 local disaster drill. Computes the household amounts (water 3 L, 3 meals, 5 portable-toilet uses per person per day), the gap against what you have, the building era (旧耐震 = 建築確認 before 1981-06-01) and the to-do list. Rules as of 2026-11-02. Educational, not official and not engineering or safety advice; not affiliated with 防災庁, the Cabinet Office, MLIT, MAFF, the Ministry of the Environment or any city. It doesn't inspect buildings or predict disasters.

Site: https://japan-disaster-prep.vercel.app

## Key facts (official sources below)
- The request (防災大臣 細野豪志, 2026-11-02) is a standing call to prepare for 国難級 disasters (Kuril / Japan Trench quakes, Tokyo inland quake, Nankai Trough, Mt Fuji eruption). The minister said on 2026-10-30 it is not based on any disaster or war prediction.
- Stockpile: at least 3 days, ideally 1 week. Drinking water 3 L per person per day including cooking (request text; PM's Office). Water for flushing and washing is separate (fill the bath, keep a tank).
- Portable toilets: 5 uses per person per day → 35 per person per week; family of 4 → 140 per week (防災庁 広報ぼうさい, METI). Only about 20% of households stock them.
- Also tissues, toilet paper and daily goods; rolling stock (ローリングストック): buy a bit extra of what you use and replace it.
- Building: 建築確認 before 1981-06-01 = old quake standard (旧耐震) → 耐震診断 (city subsidies widely available); if a full retrofit is too costly, make at least the bedroom / living room safe. Wooden post-and-beam houses permitted 1981-06-01 – 2000-05-31 → MLIT 新耐震木造住宅検証法 owner self-check. Renters → ask the landlord / 管理会社.
- Furniture: assume unfixed furniture will fall; fix it, keep tall furniture out of bedrooms and away from exits.
- Pets: food and water at least 5 days, ideally 7+ (Ministry of the Environment).
- Hazard maps: 重ねるハザードマップ / わがまちハザードマップ at disaportal.gsi.go.jp; 揺れやすさマップ and 津波ハザードマップ from your city.

## API (free, no key, CORS open)

### GET
GET https://japan-disaster-prep.vercel.app/api/check?adults=2&children=2&days=7&builtYear=1979&buildingType=wood
→ verdict "not_prepared", summary "0 of 5 done. For 4 people, 7 days: 84 L water (42 × 2 L), 84 meals, 140 toilet uses. Get a 耐震診断.", stockpile {water {target 84, minimum3Days 36, have null, gap null, bottles2L 42}, meals {target 84}, toiletUses {target 140}, pets, alsoStock[], rollingStock}, building {era "old_standard", action}, request [{n, title, ja, status done|partial|todo, todo[]} ×5], links, note, sources, disclaimer

### POST
POST https://japan-disaster-prep.vercel.app/api/check
{"adults":1,"days":3,"haveWaterLiters":9,"haveMeals":9,"haveToiletUses":15,"builtYear":"平成24","furnitureFixed":true,"hazardMapChecked":true,"evacuationRouteChecked":true,"goBagReady":true,"drillJoined":true}
→ verdict "well_prepared", doneCount 5

Parameters: adults (default 1), children, infants (water only; milk and diapers listed), elderly, dogs, cats, days (1–30, default 7), haveWaterLiters, haveMeals, haveToiletUses, builtYear (1979, 昭和54, S54, 平成12, H12), permitDate (YYYY-MM-DD 建築確認日), buildingType (wood | non_wood | unknown; 木造, マンション…), tenure (own | rent; 持ち家, 賃貸), seismicDone, furnitureFixed, hazardMapChecked, evacuationRouteChecked, goBagReady, drillJoined.

Verdicts: well_prepared (all 5 done) | partly_prepared | not_prepared. Building eras: old_standard | likely_old (built 1981, check the permit date) | new_pre2000_wood | new_standard | unknown.

Bad input → 400 {error, docs, example, disclaimer}: no people, days outside 1–30, unreadable year, invalid date or enum, non-boolean flags, negative amounts.
